mapper.sql: id, content_type, content_id, content_owner_id, source, category, severity, priority, reason, context_snapshot::text AS context_snapshot, report_count, status, resolution_note, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moderation_flags (id, content_type, content_id, content_owner_id, source, category, severity, priority, reason, context_snapshot, report_count, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{contentOwnerId}, #{source}, #{category}, #{severity}, #{priority}, #{reason}, #{contextSnapshot}::jsonb, #{reportCount}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (content_type, content_id, source, category) DO UPDATE SET report_count = moderation_flags.report_count + EXCLUDED.report_count, priority = GREATEST(moderation_flags.priority, EXCLUDED.priority) + LEAST(moderation_flags.report_count, 20), status = CASE WHEN moderation_flags.status = 'REMOVED' THEN moderation_flags.status ELSE 'PENDING' END, reason = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.reason, moderation_flags.reason), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE moderation_flags SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = NOW(), resolution_note = #{resolutionNote}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_reports (id, content_type, content_id, reporter_id, reason, note, flag_id, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}, #{note}, #{flagId}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE content_reports SET status = #{status} WHERE flag_id = #{flagId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_takedowns (id, content_type, content_id, owner_id, category, reason, removed_by, removed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{ownerId}, #{category}, #{reason}, #{removedBy}, #{removedAt}) ON CONFLICT (content_type, content_id) DO UPDATE SET reason = EXCLUDED.reason, category = EXCLUDED.category, removed_by = EXCLUDED.removed_by, removed_at = EXCLUDED.removed_at, restored_by = NULL, restored_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM content_takedowns WHERE content_type = #{contentType} AND content_id = #{contentId} AND restored_at IS NULL

mapper.update: UPDATE content_takedowns SET restored_by = #{restoredBy}, restored_at = NOW() WHERE content_type = #{contentType} AND content_id = #{contentId} AND restored_at IS NULL
